text.description_html:
AHI SD-SIG414-630, 9-1/4" Contemporary Stainless Steel Shower Handles

This contemporary styled shower handles comes packaged with everything you'll need to install them on a 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch thick glass doors. They can be used as shower door pulls or as store front pulls. Made of solid stainless steel the 9-1/4 Inch Stainless Steel Shower Handles have a Satin Stainless Steel finish. Stainless steel requires very little maintenance.

Specifications for the AHI SD-SIG414-630 Contemporary Shower Handles:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 9-1/8" (231 mm)
  • Mounting Centers: 8-1/2" (216 mm)
  • Projection: 2-1/2" (64 mm)
  • Handle Diameter: 1" (25 mm)
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.

Packaged with 2 door pulls and mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.



Item Discontinued. See available Shower Door Pulls
